scope_limit: DORA Vendor Assurance is currently bounded to reviewing supplied vendor, ICT-service, contract, control, resilience and evidence records against explicitly supplied requirements for authorised human review. It does not determine DORA legal compliance, classify regulatory criticality, approve outsourcing, make a contracting decision, submit to a regulator, or authorise external release.
review_pack_title: DIO DORA Vendor Assurance Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: DORA legal conclusions, criticality classification, outsourcing approval, contracting decisions, regulator submissions and final release remain with authorised legal, risk, procurement and regulatory owners.
